items.stem: A trader holds eight positions, but all are large-cap technology stocks. Why is this weakly diversified?

options.text: The positions are highly correlated, so they tend to move and lose together
options.rationale: Correct: diversification depends on low correlation, not the raw number of positions.

options.text: Eight positions is always too few to diversify
options.rationale: The count is not the issue; the shared correlation is.

options.text: Technology stocks cannot be held in a portfolio
options.rationale: They can be held; the concern is concentration in one correlated group.
Diversification applies across any correlated holdings, including stocks.

items.explanation: Correct: diversification depends on low correlation, not the raw number of positions.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO actions genuinely reduce portfolio-level risk? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Adding a position whose returns are uncorrelated with the existing book
options.rationale: Correct: low-correlation additions reduce aggregate volatility.

options.text: Capping total portfolio heat so simultaneous losses are bounded
options.rationale: Correct: limiting aggregate risk controls worst-case drawdown.

options.text: Doubling the size of the single best-performing position
options.rationale: Concentrating into one position increases, not reduces, risk.

options.text: Adding more positions that are all highly correlated
options.rationale: Correlated additions do not reduce portfolio risk.

items.explanation: Correct: low-correlation additions reduce aggregate volatility.

items.stem: What does performance attribution help an active trader understand?

options.text: Which strategies or decisions drove the portfolio's results
options.rationale: Correct: attribution breaks results down by source so the trader can act on it.

options.text: The exact price a stock will reach next week
options.rationale: Attribution explains past results; it does not forecast prices.

options.text: How to eliminate all portfolio risk
options.rationale: Attribution analyses results; it does not remove risk.

options.text: Which broker has the lowest fees
options.rationale: Fee comparison is unrelated to performance attribution.

items.explanation: Correct: attribution breaks results down by source so the trader can act on it.
